note: Temporary Tax Suspension: Suspended collection of the state motor fuel excise tax pursuant to executive emergency declarations, extended through late November 2026.

Temporary Tax Suspension: Signed on October 9, 2026, Session Law 2026-62 temporarily suspends North Carolina's motor fuel excise tax on gasoline, diesel, and alternative fuels from October 10 through November 30, 2026. The rate is set to 0¢ per gallon. Applicable sales and use taxes and the motor fuel inspection tax remain separate and in effect.
Temporary Tax Suspension: Suspended collection of the state Gasoline Excise Tax and Gasoline Use Tax pursuant to energy emergency executive declarations, extended through early December 2026.

Temporary Tax Reduction: Signed on October 1, 2026, House Bill 519 temporarily reduces the state motor fuel tax rate on gasoline and diesel from 38.5¢ and 47¢ down to $0.0001 (one-hundredth of a cent) per gallon from October 4, 2026, through January 2, 2027.

Temporary Tax Reduction: Following emergency legislation signed by Governor Mike DeWine, Ohio has enacted a temporary motor fuel tax holiday reducing the state motor fuel tax rate on gasoline and diesel from 38.5¢ and 47¢ down to one-hundredth of one cent ($0.0001) per gallon from October 4, 2026, through January 2, 2027.

Rate Increase Pause: Public Act 104-0468, signed on June 16, 2026, suspended the scheduled July 1, 2026, Consumer Price Index inflation adjustment on motor fuel tax rates for six months, holding rates steady through December 31, 2026.
